title: Internal: Credit Card Retention Protocol
summary: Internal: Credit Card Retention Protocol describes a 7-step closure workflow: verify no pending disputes (get_user_dispute_history_7291) and no pending replacement cards (get_pending_replacement_orders_5765), confirm account age ≥60 days and outstanding balance $0.00, then check closure-reason history within past year (get_closure_reason_history_8293) to decide whether to skip retention offers. It requires asking/logging a closure reason via log_credit_card_closure_reason_4521 (annual_fee, not_using_card, found_better_card, unhappy_with_rewards, simplifying_finances, negative_experience, other), offering tailored solutions (including annual-fee waiver via apply_credit_card_account_flag_6147 with expiration = one year from today in MM/DD/YYYY) and then making exactly one retention offer by tier (Entry: 500 points or $5 credit; Mid: 2,000 points or $20 credit; Premium+: 5,000 points or $50 credit). If closure proceeds, inform customer they have 45 days to redeem unredeemed rewards and may receive a full refund if the annual fee was charged within 37 days.
